items.title: BPCL reports 21.45% drop in Q2 FY27 net profit, attributes losses to fuel pricing issues
items.description: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) has reported a 21.45% decline in consolidated net profit for Q2 FY27. The decline is attributed to losses from the sale of petrol, diesel, and LPG, which affected marketing margins. Consolidated revenue from operations increased by 29.7% compared to the previous fiscal year. As of September 30, 2026, BPCL's cumulative under recoveries on LPG reached ₹17,334.40 crore.

items.title: DRL says cap on trade margins a positive, posts 36% dip in Q2 PAT
items.description: In the second quarter of FY2027, Dr. Reddy's Labs experienced a downturn in both revenue and profit. However, the company supports new trade margin regulations that aim to improve access to vital medicines. With a commitment to boosting its core business performance, management is also dedicated to exploring growth avenues.

items.title: Adani Power profit surges 142% on strong demand amid weak rains
items.description: Adani Power has reported a 142% increase in net profit for the July-September quarter. This profit was driven by strong electricity demand and exceptional prior-period income. Operating revenue for the company saw a nearly 30% increase compared to the previous year. The company also recognized significant revenue due to adjustments in historic energy charges under its power purchase agreements.

items.title: JSW Steel posts three-fold jump in profit, lines up capacity expansion
items.description: JSW Steel achieved an impressive three-fold rise in its consolidated net profit for the September quarter, highlighted by a record-breaking 13% increase in sales volumes compared to last year. The company has received approval for ambitious expansion projects, aiming to add 5 million tonnes at the Utkal site in Odisha.

items.title: IndusInd Bank posts Rs 1,242 crore net profit on lower provisions
items.description: IndusInd Bank reported an impressive consolidated net profit of ₹1,242 crore for the September quarter, marking a robust recovery from the previous year's loss of ₹437 crore. This turnaround stems from decreased provisions and heightened fee income, alongside encouraging trends in asset quality, evidenced by reduced non-performing asset ratios. The bank's financial outlook showcases a significant improvement in both growth and profitability.

items.title: Infosys upbeat on deals, cautious on growth as competition intensifies
items.description: Infosys released its quarterly results, showing good revenue growth and stable operating margins. However, the management reduced the annual revenue guidance due to competitive pressures. The company secured a significant $2 billion deal, boosting its total contract value to $5.2 billion. Despite positive performance from some sectors, weaknesses in others contributed to the cautious outlook. The market response led to a rise in the stock price, affecting valuation metrics.

items.title: Infosys Q2 net profit rises 6.2%; projects weakest growth in seven years
items.description: Revenue rose 10.7% yearly and 2.1% quarter-on-quarter to reach Rs 49,244 crore. Infosys lowered its guidance for 2026-27 to 1-2% in constant currency terms, its weakest estimate in seven years, down from an earlier range of 1.5-3%. Last quarter, it had trimmed the upper end from 3.5% earlier.

items.title: Coforge Q2 net profit jumps 56.5% to Rs 588 crore on Encora deal
items.description: Revenue for the September quarter increased 53.6% year-on-year and 11.6% sequentially to Rs 6,170.8 crore. In dollar terms, revenue stood at $652.2 million, up 10.1% from the preceding quarter on constant currency terms. Contribution from the Encora acquisition was a major reason for the revenue growth this quarter along with large deals.

items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 results: Consolidated PAT rises 26% YoY to Rs 5,645 crore;  NII up 16%
items.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank has announced an impressive 26% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax for the second quarter, highlighting strong financial performance. Their standalone profit after tax surged by 29% compared to last year’s figures. Additionally, net interest income saw a rise of 16% year-on-year, hitting Rs 8,459 crore. Customer assets also grew significantly, reaching Rs 6,99,250 crore, while the capital adequacy ratio remains robust at 22.

items.title: AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to Rs 858 crore
items.description: AU's gross non-performing assets ratio fell 42 basis points (bps) to 1.99% at the end of September. This helped in 25% lower provision at Rs 359 crore against Rs 481 crore. Net NPA ratio improved by 7 bps to 0.81%. Annualised credit cost improved by 45 bps to 0.8% from 1.2% over the year.
